name: Larry Williams %R(3) between -87 and -20 buy at open, exit same session
author: Larry Williams idea; Pine port

entry_long: On a daily bar, if %R(3) = 100*(close-highest(close? source,3))/(max-min) is below -20 and above -87 (not oversold, not overbought), buy at next open.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Description states "highly profitable on daily Nasdaq"; no figures captured. %R formula in script uses close vs highest/lowest of source series.
